setting_lore: The Blackwood was once a thriving forest, home to the Sylvari elves. A century ago, a blight cursed the land. Trees gained sentience and malice. The elves vanished. Now the forest twists all who enter, and the trees whisper ancient grudges.

factions.name: Twisted Wardens
factions.description: Corrupted treants that patrol the forest, hunting intruders.

factions.name: Ghostlight Wisps
factions.description: Mischievous spirits that lead travelers astray.

key_locations.name: The Heartwood Glade
key_locations.description: The blighted center of the forest where the curse originated.

narrative_rules: The forest is alive and reacts to violence.
Fire is both feared and effective against the corrupted flora.
